items.hook: Water Baby is a 2024 novel by Nigerian author Chioma Okereke, published by Quercus.
items.body: The novel tells the story of a 19-year-old girl called Baby, who struggles to meet her dream in a rural community Makoko in Lagos, Nigeria. One of those things you can't un-know.

items.hook: Psycho-Pass is a Japanese cyberpunk psychological thriller anime television series produced by Production I.G.
items.body: It was co-directed by Naoyoshi Shiotani and Katsuyuki Motohiro and written by Gen Urobuchi, with character designs by Akira Amano and featuring music by Yugo Kanno. The world is stranger than it lets on.

items.hook: The Flanagan Boy is a 1949 crime thriller novel by the British author Max Catto.
items.body: The plot has some similarities that of The Postman Always Rings Twice and its 1946 Hollywood film adaptation. Worth a quiet trip down the rabbit hole.

items.hook: Devdas is a 1935 Bengali film directed by Pramathesh Barua and based on the 1917 Sharat Chandra Chattopadhyay novel, Devdas.
items.body: It stars Barua as Devdas, Jamuna Barua as Parvati (Paro) and Chandrabati Devi as Chandramukhi. One of those things you can't un-know.
